close_reason: Added mta_sts_enforcer: Option<Arc<MtaStsEnforcer>> to SmtpRelayQueue struct and new(). deliver_via_relay now receives self.mta_sts_enforcer.as_deref() instead of None. Production wiring (pass actual enforcer from config) is stoa-wfcj7.8.
description: relay_queue.rs:490 calls deliver_via_relay with None for the MTA-STS enforcer — SmtpRelayQueue has no MtaStsEnforcer field, never initializes one, and enqueue() has no require_tls parameter. Even with mta_sts.enabled=true in config, enforcement is never applied on the actual delivery path. The feature advertised in feat(smtp): MTA-STS is a complete no-op at runtime.
title: MTA-STS enforcer not wired into relay_queue drain path
